- Moved "Write report" to Done (shot_after_move.png).
- Reloaded the page — all three cards persisted with "Write report" still in Done (shot_after_reload.png), confirmed both in the page state and in cards.json on disk.

Everything worked; no fixes were needed.
Add a dark mode toggle, test it in the browser, and send me a final screenshot.
